# Star Core Artefact And Temporal View

Status: design. Source inspection: 2026-09-08.

September 8 direction places a selected core artefact or image inside the Star. Intrinsic SHAPE(key) remains distinct from a context- and time-dependent view. The moving-ceiling source and assumptions govern the surrounding temporal reading.

No new decay equation, measured activity, or credential authority is asserted.
